question.prompt: Someone says \(36 \div 6 = 5\). Check using multiplication: what is \(6 \times 5\)? Is it equal to 36? First calculate \(6 \times 5\). Calculate: \(6 \times 5 = ?\)

solutions.explanation: \(6 \times 5 = 30\), which is not equal to 36, so the quotient is not 5.
solutions.title: Multiplication check
